arxiv-2204-01061.title: Task2Dial: A Novel Task and Dataset for Commonsense enhanced Task-based Dialogue Grounded in Documents
arxiv-2204-01061.creator: Carl Strathearn, Dimitra Gkatzia
arxiv-2204-01061.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novel task on commonsense-enhanced task-based dialogue grounded in documents and describes the Task2Dial dataset, a novel dataset of document-grounded task-based dialogues, where an Information Giver (IG) provides instructions (by consulting a document) to an Information Follower (IF), so that the latter can successfully complete the task.

arxiv-2307-16733.title: Painting baryons onto N N -body simulations of galaxy clusters with image-to-image deep learning 2023 Painting baryons onto N N -body simulations of galaxy clusters with image-to-image deep learning – 12
arxiv-2307-16733.creator: Urmila Chadayammuri, Michelle Ntampaka, John ZuHone, Ákos Bogdán, Ralph P. Kraft
arxiv-2307-16733.description: Abstract Galaxy cluster mass functions are a function of cosmology, but mass is not a direct observable, and systematic errors abound in all its observable proxies. Mass-free inference can bypass this challenge, but it requires large suites of simulations spanning a range of cosmologies and models for directly observable quantities.

arxiv-2407-05095.title: Weighted cone-volume measures of pseudo-cones
arxiv-2407-05095.creator: Rolf Schneider
arxiv-2407-05095.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rolf Schneider. A pseudo-cone in ℝ n {\mathbb{R}}^{n} is a nonempty closed convex set K K not containing the origin and such that λ ​ K ⊆ K \lambda K\subseteq K for all λ ≥ 1 \lambda\geq 1 . It is called a C C -pseudo-cone if C C is its recession cone, where C C is a pointed closed convex cone with interior points. The cone-volume measure of a pseudo-cone can be defined similarly as for convex bodies, but it may be infinite.

arxiv-2410-03075.title: Multilingual Topic Classification in X: Dataset and Analysis
arxiv-2410-03075.creator: Dimosthenis Antypas, Asahi Ushio, Francesco Barbieri, Jose Camacho-Collados
arxiv-2410-03075.description: Abstract In the dynamic realm of social media, diverse topics are discussed daily, transcending linguistic boundaries. However, the complexities of understanding and categorising this content across various languages remain an important challenge with traditional techniques like topic modelling often struggling to accommodate this multilingual diversity.

arxiv-2509-20897.title: Higher-Order Root-Finding Algorithm and its Applications
arxiv-2509-20897.creator: Wei Guo Foo, Chik How Tan
arxiv-2509-20897.description: Abstract Root-finding method is an iterative process that constructs a sequence converging to a solution of an equation. Householder’s method is a higher-order method that requires higher order derivatives of the reciprocal of a function and has disadvantages. Firstly, symbolic computations can take a long time, and numerical methods to differentiate a function can accumulate errors.

britannica-1911-paulus-heinrich-eberhard.title: Paulus, Heinrich Eberhard Gottlob (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-paulus-heinrich-eberhard.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-paulus-heinrich-eberhard.description: Article 'Paulus, Heinrich Eberhard Gottlob' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. German rationalistic theologian, was born at Leonberg, near Stuttgart, on the 1st of September 1761. His father, a Lutheran clergyman at Leonberg, dabbled in spiritualism, and was deprived of his living in 1771. Paulus was educated in the seminary at Tübingen, was three years master in a German school, and then spent two years in travelling through England, Germany, Holland and France.

pmc-10743385.title: The Influence of Interval Training Combined with Occlusion and Cooling on Selected Indicators of Blood, Muscle Metabolism and Oxidative Stress
pmc-10743385.creator: Bartłomiej Ptaszek, Szymon Podsiadło, Olga Czerwińska-Ledwig, Bartosz Zając, Rafał Niżankowski, Piotr Mika, Aneta Teległów, Kazuhisa Asai, Yoshiaki Minakata
pmc-10743385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). There is increasing evidence to support the use of interval training and/or low-impact blood flow restriction exercises in musculoskeletal rehabilitation. The aim of the study was to assess the effect of interval training combined with occlusion and cooling in terms of changes in selected blood parameters affecting the development and progression of atherosclerosis of the lower limbs, as well as selected parameters of muscle metabolism and oxidative stress affecting the growth of muscle mass and regeneration after training.

pmc-11397521.title: The Stability of UV-Defluorination-Driven Crosslinked Carbon Nanotubes: A Raman Study
pmc-11397521.creator: Yunxiang Gao, Mohammad Tarequl Islam, Promise Uzoamaka Otuokere, Merlyn Pulikkathara, Yuemin Liu, Maurizio Muniz-Miranda
pmc-11397521.description: Carbon nanotubes (CNTs) are often regarded as semi-rigid, all-carbon polymers. However, unlike conventional polymers that can form 3D networks such as hydrogels or elastomers through crosslinking in solution, CNTs have long been considered non-crosslinkable under mild conditions. This perception changed with our recent discovery of UV-defluorination-driven direct crosslinking of CNTs in solution.

pmc-11495548.title: Spatial modeling and ecological suitability of Ebola virus disease in Africa
pmc-11495548.creator: Lombo Baluma Didier, Lukusa Lumu Jude, Esuka Igabuchia Franck, HaoNing Wang, Xiao-Long Wang, Adam R. Aluisio, Clement Ameh Yaro, Clement Ameh Yaro, Clement Ameh Yaro
pmc-11495548.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This paper looks into the MaxEnt model in a trial to comprehend the ecological and environmental conditions that propagate and drive the spread of Ebola Virus Disease in Africa. We use the MaxEnt model to assess risk determinants associated with the occurrence and distribution of EVD, taking into account non-correlated variables such as neighborhood mean temperature, rainfall, and human population density.

pmc-13359749.creator: Lorenzo Fruscella, Diego Antonio Sicuso, Daria Vitale, Annamaria Passantino
pmc-13359749.description: Simple SummaryThe global consumption of decapod crustaceans is characterized by a paradox: while economic value and exploitation scales reach unprecedented levels, the legal protection afforded to these animals remains remarkably rudimentary.
